<thought>The spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with rapidly decreasing intensity, which is the characteristic isotopic envelope of carbon (C‑12/C‑13) in a molecule containing multiple carbons. No other element has a distinctive pattern that can be unambiguously identified from this data. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
